_meta.title: Communication domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/communication.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing communication.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/communication.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME SIGNATURE AS FINANCE, plus the same extra fault. Communication shows: near-ZERO reciprocal/feedback structure (recurrentFraction 0.032, only ONE reciprocal pair A1<->MGN in 62 edges) despite carrying directed control rings, and many single points of failure (10 articulation nodes). EXTRA fault (shared with Finance, absent in Energy): the graph is already fractured into 2 components at baseline — the {M1, SMA} motor dyad is fully disconnected from the main body. Communication's main body is 38 nodes.

recurrenceAudit.note: Exactly ONE reciprocal pair exists (A1<->MGN: A1->MGN 'SUPPLIES' and MGN->A1 'excit'), giving reciprocalEdges 2 / recurrentFraction 0.032 — effectively the feedforward-only signature the neuro reference calls the broken version. The graph carries directed cycles (the business-layer CONTROLS ring BROCA->A1->NAcc->CC->FPN->WERN->BROCA), but for essentially no edge A->B does B->A exist. verdict from the module = 'has recurrent/lateral structure' ONLY because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.333) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is all but absent.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: TWO components at baseline. Main body = 38 nodes; a fully disconnected dyad = {M1, SMA} (only internal edge SMA->M1, no edge in or out of the main body). This pre-existing fracture is the extra fault (shared with Finance; Energy baseComponents=1).

mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaf LGN (LGN->V1 is LGN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: sole attachment of TWO leaves — VP (NAcc->VP is VP's only edge) and VTA (VTA->NAcc is VTA's only edge); removing NAcc isolates both (+2 components).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dACC: sole bridge of the interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} to the main body — AI->dACC is that island's only link out.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.BLA: sole attachment of leaf rACC (rACC->BLA is rACC's only edge). (LC also touches BLA but stays attached via LC->PVN.)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.PVN: sole attachment of leaf HYPO (PVN->HYPO is HYPO's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG is PAG's only edge). (CeA also touches vmPFC but stays attached via mPFC->CeA.)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: sole attachment of leaf S1 (THAL->S1 only) AND of the {STRI, GP} basal-ganglia cluster (GP->THAL is that cluster's only link to the body); removing THAL isolates both (+2 components).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of TWO leaves — NTS (NTS->AI only) and PI (PI->AI only); removing AI isolates both (+2 components).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.GP: sole attachment of leaf STRI (STRI->GP is STRI's only edge).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the thalamo-cortico-thalamic somatosensory loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, somatosensory relay). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain (feedback outnumbers feedforward), functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', THAL = motif M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes V1 = 'primary visual processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the conflict/error signal feeds back to the executive to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; they are adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds forward-and-back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience<->reward loop that the business-layer edge NAcc->dACC ('SUPPLIES') opens: reward drive supplies the conflict/salience monitor, and the monitor projects back to bias reward selection.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->dACC (SUPPLIES). The anterior cingulate cortex sends a canonical glutamatergic corticostriatal (cingulostriatal) projection to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens. canonical-nodes dACC = M6 conflict/error monitor, NAcc = M11 reward drive.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: NAcc is the sole attachment of BOTH VP and VTA. This mesocortical edge gives VTA a body anchor independent of NAcc; removing NAcc then leaves VTA attached via mPFC (and VP attached via the VP->VTA edge below).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', mPFC = 'medial PFC — self-referential value integration (DMN core)'. The mesocortical dopamine projection VTA->mPFC is a canonical ascending dopaminergic pathway. mPFC is a main-body node (mPFC->BLA/CeA/PVN in-graph).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches NAcc's second leaf, VP (NAcc->VP is VP's only edge). VP->VTA gives VP a second anchor; with VTA now attached via mPFC, removing NAcc leaves VP attached via VTA. Doubles as recurrence: closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'. One edge serves both recurrence and redundancy.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The {STRI, GP} basal-ganglia cluster reaches the body only via GP->THAL. A cingulostriatal corticostriatal input gives the cluster a second bridge; removing THAL then leaves {STRI, GP} attached via dACC. This edge ALSO de-articulates GP (GP's leaf STRI now has a second in-edge).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes dACC = M6 conflict/error monitor; the anterior cingulate is a principal cortical source of the corticostriatal projection to the striatum (cingulostriatal, canonical). STRI is a composite view (CAUD+PUT+NAcc) already present as an in-graph edge endpoint (STRI->GP).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches THAL's leaf S1 (THAL->S1 is S1's only edge). Once the {M1, SMA} dyad is reconnected to the body (SMA->STRI below), a somatomotor S1->M1 edge gives S1 a body path that does not pass through THAL, fully de-articulating THAL. (In Finance this same edge was recorded as groundable-but-not-added because a separate ungroundable CBLM leaf kept THAL articulate; in Communication CBLM is NOT a THAL-only leaf, so adding S1->M1 here DOES clear THAL.)
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. The S1->M1 corticocortical projection is the canonical dense reciprocal somatomotor connection integrating sensory feedback into motor output.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} reaches the main body only via AI->dACC, so removing dACC isolates the whole island. An anterior-insula -> orbitofrontal edge gives the island a second bridge; removing dACC then leaves {AI, NTS, PI} attached via OFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The anterior insula projects to the orbitofrontal cortex, carrying interoceptive/gustatory signal into valuation (canonical insula->OFC pathway). canonical-nodes AI = M10 interoceptive salience, OFC = M6 valuation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: AI splits into TWO leaves on removal: PI (PI->AI only) and NTS (NTS->AI only). This edge reattaches the PI leaf: a posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor. Paired with the NTS->PVN edge below, it fully de-articulates AI.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches AI's second leaf, NTS (NTS->AI only). A visceral-afferent -> hypothalamus edge gives NTS a second anchor; removing AI then leaves NTS attached via PVN. Together with PI->dACC this drops AI from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes NTS = M10 'visceral afferent hub'. The nucleus tractus solitarius sends a canonical ascending projection to the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (visceral-afferent -> autonomic/neuroendocrine relay). PVN is already an in-graph node (target of BLA->PVN, HIPP->PVN, LC->PVN; source of PVN->HYPO).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: rACC reaches the graph only via rACC->BLA, so removing BLA isolates it. A medial-PFC affective-regulation edge gives rACC a second anchor; removing BLA then leaves rACC attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation', vmPFC = M1 top-down brake. rACC and vmPFC are adjacent ventromedial affective-regulation regions with reciprocal connectivity (the emotion-regulation medial-PFC cluster).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output'; PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway. CeA already has in-graph afferents (mPFC->CeA, vmPFC->CeA), so this adds the needed CeA efferent.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as a COMPOSITE view ('not an edge endpoint'; remapTo view, HYPO->PIT->ADR loop); the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HYPO reaches the graph only via PVN->HYPO, so removing PVN isolates it. A hypothalamic descending edge to the PAG gives HYPO a second anchor; with PAG reattached (via CeA above), removing PVN then leaves HYPO attached via PAG.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes HYPO = M3 'homeostatic set-point', PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The medial-hypothalamus -> dorsal-PAG projection is a canonical descending defensive/autonomic pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: EXTRA-FAULT FIX (not a classic articulation node). {M1, SMA} is a fully disconnected component at baseline. A corticostriatal edge reattaches the dyad to the main body (STRI is reachable from the main body once dACC->STRI is added), reducing baseComponents 2->1. Paired with THAL->M1 below so the dyad has TWO independent bridges.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'; SMA is a principal cortical source of the motor corticostriatal projection to putamen/striatum (canonical). STRI already an in-graph edge endpoint (STRI->GP).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Second independent bridge for the disconnected {M1, SMA} dyad. Also the canonical final leg of the cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamo-cortical motor loop, whose output limb STRI->GP->THAL is already in-graph.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. The ventral-anterior/ventral-lateral thalamus -> M1 projection is the canonical thalamocortical motor relay and the return leg of the BG loop already half-present in-graph (STRI->GP inhib, GP->THAL inhib).

projectedImpact.method: The 21 proposed edges (8 feedback + 13 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of communication.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. communication.json itself was NOT modified.

recurrentFraction.note: crosses the 0.2 tree-vs-mesh threshold. The 9 reciprocal pairs = the pre-existing A1<->MGN pair + the 8 proposedFeedbackEdges (each is the reverse of a pre-existing edge). Still far below the ~0.8 cortical benchmark; this is a first, honest pass, not a full mesh.

lateralFractionOfClassifiable.note: unchanged — no proposed edge joins two same-group activation nodes; the additions are cross-group anatomical/feedback edges.

baseComponents.note: the {M1, SMA} dyad is reconnected by SMA->STRI + THAL->M1; the graph becomes a single connected body.

articulationNodes.reason: The single residual articulation point is V1, which survives solely because its dedicated leaf LGN (a retino-recipient visual thalamic relay) has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated (see _omittedForLackOfGrounding). This is the same honest floor Finance/Energy bottomed out at for the LGN/MGN dedicated-relay reason. THAL — an articulation point in every prior domain's floor — is CLEARED here because CBLM is not a THAL-only leaf (it attaches via WERN/FEF), so S1->M1 + dACC->STRI fully de-articulate it.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay (canonical-nodes: 'lateral geniculate — visual thalamic relay') whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the communication graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1, so V1 remains a residual articulation point.

Hippocampal output to lateral PFC is not a monosynaptic projection; direct hippocampal-PFC fibers target mPFC/vmPFC, not dlPFC, and the mPFC relay is not on a communication-graph edge path. Cannot ground a direct HIPP->dlPFC edge, so the dlPFC->HIPP edge is left without its reciprocal.

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedNotOmitted: MGN (medial geniculate, auditory thalamic relay) is a dedicated relay analogous to LGN, but it is NOT an articulation node in this graph (degree 5: A1<->MGN, MGN->STS, MGN->dACC, vlPFC->MGN), so it needs no redundant path. The A1->THAL feedback edge additionally strengthens the auditory relay's coupling.
